axis_name: legal-reasoning correctness and defeater sensitivity
e_star_mechanism: Every admitted legal conclusion is emitted as a proof-carrying evidence-rank certificate on a TYPED DEFEASIBLE LATTICE, produced by a pure (no-I/O, no-clock, no-randomness) derivation function whose acceptance certificate is byte-for-byte reproducible. Buildable today: extend orchestrator-epistemic/negation-layer.lisp (OWL AllDisjointClasses canonical-negation already present) into a defeater-closure gate, where a conclusion node cannot enter :accepted unless (a) its rebutting/undercutting/statutory-exception defeater set is ENUMERATED, (b) each defeater carries an explicit status token {defeated | undefeated | UNKNOWN}, and (c) UNKNOWN is a first-class lattice element (the %emit-tsa-ca-or-honest-note honest-note pattern in deploy-epistemic.lisp generalised) that is NEVER collapsed to :equal or :absent. The trusted derivation path contains NO LLM (README: 'Zero shell-script orchestration in the trusted path; the entrypoint is Lisp'); any LLM output is untrusted candidate input that must pass the pure gate. The certificate is the same reproducible artifact verified by determinism/*/verify/verify.lisp (Ironclad, pure Lisp).
why_above_commercial_floor: The baseline floor (citation validation + source-grounding) certifies that a cited authority EXISTS and was retrieved; it does not certify that the conclusion's DEFEATERS were enumerated, nor that the conclusion itself was produced outside an LLM. E_star's guarantee is: no conclusion is admitted with an un-enumerated defeater set, and no LLM sits in the trusted path that stamped it. That is a structural non-existence guarantee (a class of error made impossible), not a bigger citation-check number.
delta_definition: Logical axis. delta_a = a typed evidence-lattice rank gap of AT LEAST ONE level. Rank is the tuple (defeater-closure ∈ {open, closed}, ignorance-handling ∈ {collapsed, honest-total}, trusted-path ∈ {LLM-in-path, LLM-excluded}). A conclusion is STRICTLY stronger iff it dominates on this partial order with at least one strict coordinate and none weaker. Measurement instrument: the pure gate emits, per conclusion, a machine-checkable rank token; the gap is the count of coordinates on which E_star's token strictly exceeds the baseline's DECLARED capability token. Pre-registered strict threshold: gap >= 1.

Transaction-time is enforced monotonic at the write seat (non-monotonic-transaction-time).
